title: Lyle Mcdonald's inspired 4 Days Upper Lower program review
summary: NH reviews a viewer's version of Lyle McDonald's generic upper/lower bulking routine. He likes the compound backbone and rep ranges, but splits the upper day into synergistic A/B days, adds deadlifts to the lower days, and suggests supersetting calves, abs and shrugs to cover small muscles.
claims: 3-4 sets of 6-8 reps on flat bench is a good evolving set and rep range: one set and two reps of play
With 'row of choice', pick one row type and stay in one tree of specificity
Lift variations should stay in the same movement-pattern line: incline bench and chest fly are not interchangeable
For 2-3 sets, widen the range to 8-12 reps instead of 10-12 or you sandbag
Always prefer pull-ups over pulldowns, for athleticism and hypertrophy; vertical pulls tolerate high volume, so 3-5 sets is fine
Lateral raises and rear delt flyes do better with 8-12 reps than 8-10
Proposed Upper A: flat bench, incline bench superset with pull-ups, then a giant set of lateral raises and biceps; no triceps because two heavy presses cover them
Proposed Upper B: incline bench as strength work, chest fly superset with pulldowns, then rear delt fly superset with a triceps exercise
3-4 sets of 6-8 on back squat is high volume; drop to 2-3 sets or use 4-6 reps if needed; high or low bar depends on your build
Squats followed by RDLs is an excellent pairing for big legs
Lower days need fewer exercises than upper days because the tonnage is so high; legs do not need isolation, just squat
You need deadlifts from the floor; RDLs alone are not enough, they are a variation that carries over to the deadlift
Proposed Lower A: back squat, RDL, optional leg extension superset with leg curl; Lower B: deadlift then split squats or pause squats, then the extension/curl superset
Calves and abs take no extra time because you can superset them anywhere; small muscles have little work capacity, recover fast and should be hit as often as possible
For traps, shrug at the top of your last RDL set until failure, then strip 20 lb and shrug again, repeating
He will review paywalled programs from their exercise selection and philosophy alone
exercises: shrug at top of last set, strip 20 lb and repeat
Calf raises / knee raises / leg raises
